note: Every end time here is the end of the event's own printed level table (levels x level length plus the published breaks), compared as minutes from the start day's midnight. It is a MAXIMUM, not an official finish time: no sheet in the series prints an end clock, and an event ends when its field is paid - or, for a satellite, when its seats are awarded - which can be much earlier. Of the 93 rows the official page labels "(1Day)", 87 carry a table that runs past midnight and 70 cannot fit inside a day at all (flag F75). A table spanning more than one playing day bounds its first day not at all, so those rows carry no ceiling and their day is never paired. A day names one primary candidate (subject to written rules) and, only where the primary cannot run past the second event's entry deadline, a conditional fallback labelled from the start or as a join in progress. Everything else on that date is listed as an alternative to the primary, never as an addition to it.
